plain_text:
Lon Clark appears in 27 recordings across 8 programs in the Golden Radio Hour archive from 1943 to 1974. The credits here include performer.

In this archive, you will hear Lon Clark most often in Theater Five, Words at War, 2000 Plus, Quiet Please, CBS Radio Mystery Theater, The Adventures of the Abbotts, The Mysterious Traveler, and The Weird Circle.

Characters credited here include Nick Carter.
